name: fitzen
description: Fitzen — AI-powered sports talent assessment platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:engines && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @fitzen/server" "npm run dev -w @fitzen/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:engines && npm run dev -w @fitzen/server
scripts.build: npm run build:engines && npm run build -w @fitzen/web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true})"
scripts.test: npm run build:engines && npm run test -w @fitzen/engines && npm run test -w @fitzen/server && npm run test -w @fitzen/web
scripts.seed: npm run build:engines && npm run seed -w @fitzen/server
